# CALEBrated Virtual Services

> CALEBrated Virtual Services is a remote team of virtual assistants and specialists. We handle admin, marketing, and website work for busy small business owners, so they can get more done without hiring in-house. The first step is a free consultation call.

- Who we help: owners of small and growing businesses, mostly US home-service and trades companies (pools, plumbing, trenchless, construction, lifts, pipelines) and marketing agencies.
- How to start: book a free consultation at https://calendly.com/infocalebrated, or email infocalebrated@gmail.com.
- Numbers shown on the site: 100% Projects Success, 20+ Trusted Clients, 100% Positive Feedback, 10+ Professional Team.
- Core values: Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Client Focus.
- The website does not list prices.

## Pages

- [Home](https://calebratedvirtualservices.com/): What CALEBrated does, client logos, services, numbers, values, and booking.

- [About](https://calebratedvirtualservices.com/about): Who we are and what changes when you work with us.
- [Contact](https://calebratedvirtualservices.com/contact): Book a free consultation or send a message.
